# pve_vm_reboot (Action)

Reboot a VM by resetting it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "pve_vm_reboot" "example" {
  config {
    node = "pve1"
    vmid = 100
  }
}

# terraform_data is a no-op stand-in; wire action.pve actions to the
# lifecycle events of any managed resource.
resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_vm_reboot.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `vmid` (Number) The (unique) ID of the VM.

### Optional

- `timeout` (Number) Wait maximal timeout seconds for the shutdown.
